Gaussian input

Link 0 commands

The Link 0 commands set the job’s memory, processors and files before the route; each is explained after the Gaussian manual.

Command Value Meaning
%Chk Checkpoint file this job writes.
%Mem 1 GB Dynamic memory available to Gaussian.
%NProcShared 1 Number of processors used in shared-memory parallel execution.
%OldChk Checkpoint file copied into this job’s checkpoint at the start, to read data from a previous calculation.

Route keywords and options

The route selects the method, basis set and job type. Each keyword is listed with its meaning, followed by its options, as Gaussian read them.

Keyword

Meaning

Options

Option

Value

Meaning

PM6D3

PM6 semi-empirical method with Grimme’s D3 dispersion correction.

Opt

Geometry optimization to a stationary point.

TS

Optimize to a transition structure rather than a minimum.

Cartesian

Optimize in Cartesian coordinates.

CalcFC

Compute the force constants at the first point with the current method.

NoEigenTest

Do not test the curvature during the Berny optimization.

MaxCycles

1000

At most 1000 optimization steps.

MaxStep

5

Maximum step, the initial trust radius, of 5\times 0.01\,a_0 or 5\times 0.01\,\mathrm{rad}.

RecalcFC

10

Compute analytic second derivatives at the first step and then every 10 steps.

IOp

Internal options overriding program defaults.

1/7

1.2 \mathord{\times}10^{4}

RMS-force convergence threshold of 12000\times 10^{-6}\,E_h/a_0.

1/152

1000

Optimization step allocation of 1000.

Freq

Harmonic force constants, vibrational frequencies, intensities and thermochemistry.

NoRaman

Skip the Raman intensities.

SCF

Controls of the self-consistent field procedure.

Tight

Tight SCF convergence, the default.

XQC

Add a quadratically convergent SCF step if the first-order SCF has not converged.

MaxCycle

512

At most 512 SCF cycles.

NoSymm

Keep the input orientation and do not use molecular symmetry.

Geom

Source and handling of the molecule specification.

Connectivity

Read explicit atom bonding from an extra input section.

Geometries along the job

Every geometry Gaussian printed during the job, in order; the viewer steps through them, trailed by faded copies of the preceding geometries.

Vibrational frequencies

The harmonic analysis gave 84 modes, 3 of them imaginary. The stick spectrum places each mode’s infrared intensity at its wavenumber, imaginary modes at negative wavenumbers.

The viewer animates every imaginary mode, the six lowest real modes and the four most intense in the infrared, each with a largest atomic excursion of 0.6 \mathrm{\AA}; choose one in its snapshot selector. Faded copies spread over the mode’s frames trail the motion; the trail button on the right toolbar hides them.
